note: The World Inequality Database (WID.world, bulk download of 15 October 2026), Sierra Leone, 2024: average net personal wealth (ahwealj992) and average post-tax disposable income (adiincj992) per adult over 20, resources split equally within couples, for the bottom 20, 40, 60, 90 and 99 percent and the top 1 percent; each family's band is read from them. The database's metadata labels the figures SLL, but its market exchange rate in local currency per US dollar (xlcusxi999) is 23.17 for 2024, the redenominated leone's level, the old leone standing near 23,000, so they are read as SLE, as the database's own rates show them to be. Read 2026-10-30.
